literal_gloss: I-read John Philoponus's discourse concerning resurrection in volumes [lacuna], in which he-does-away-with the resurrection of-the bodies and says many-things also thoughtlessly, mocking also our blessed and holy fathers.
source_text: Codex 21 Greek from photius_bibliotheca_greek_lock.txt (Bekker 1824, p. 5; 2026-09-18 image n16)
